issues.title: Seven Days Staring at Bamboo
issues.concept: The unity of knowledge and action
issues.teaser: A young Chinese scholar tried to find the truth in a bamboo grove, fell ill, and years later found it somewhere else.

issues.title: The Emperor Who Said Sorry
issues.teaser: Around 260 BC an Indian emperor won a brutal war, then had his regret carved into rock across his empire.

issues.title: The Man Who Doubted the Sea
issues.teaser: On a voyage home from England in 1921, an Indian physicist refused to believe the sea was just reflecting the sky.

issues.title: The Art of Not Trying
issues.teaser: A Renaissance parlour game at the court of Urbino gave the world its rule for elegance: never let them see you try.

issues.title: The Speckled Axe
issues.teaser: Benjamin Franklin tried to make himself morally perfect with a notebook and some red ink. He failed, and was glad he tried.

issues.title: The Ending Hemingway Left Out
issues.teaser: Why Hemingway cut the most dramatic thing in a story, and why it made the story stronger.

issues.title: The Horse Who Could Count
issues.teaser: A Berlin horse who did arithmetic, a panel of experts who were fooled, and the psychologist who worked out what was really going on.

issues.title: The Great Hanoi Rat Hunt
issues.teaser: How a bounty on rat tails left colonial Hanoi with more rats, not fewer.
